name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Electric Orange
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Electric Orange is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Electric Orange brings a bright, citrus-forward profile: juicy sweet orange up front with a zesty, tangy snap and a clean, refreshing finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Electric Orange flavor — juicy sweet orange with a zesty, tangy snap
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Electric Orange is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
